generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this Contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last three years a.achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount

To qualify for award of this Contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last three years b. Work done certificate of 25 Ha/Km, 10000 seedlings, planting from Government agencies for having carried out such a type of works in last 3 years duly signed by Deputy Conservator of Forests Or any Other Equalant District level Officer

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments water tanker for watering activities or other transport vehicle
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
Copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
Caste Certificate Compulsary (for reserved categery tenders only)
